leo_cs: Quick check-in for Campbell on their private VPC flip tomorrow. Items: KMS cross-account, audit log egress to our collector + S3, service account IAM least-privilege. Renewal flagged if >2hr rollback. Any blockers?

hana_net: TGW in place. Need policy to allow VPC endpoint to s3 and outbound 443 to collector.redwood.com. Prefer endpoint to avoid NAT latency.

omar_sre: We recommend S3 endpoint + parallel uploader; staging median 24s. NAT adds ~12s. I can validate canary after SG rules updated.

tess_security: KMS: created alias/redwood/campbell-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333344445555:key/camp-321). Requesting that Campbell add our role arn:aws:iam::666677778888:role/redwood-logging with Encrypt/GenerateDataKey only. Proposing rotation 90d to match their policy.

campbell_cloudadmin: Ok to grant Encrypt/GenerateDataKey. Need diagram showing who holds Decrypt and rotation steps. Also verify we won't store raw prompts unless we sign NDA.

tess_security: We'll remove cross-account Decrypt. Our collector holds Decrypt in Redwood account. We'll send a short flow doc.

opsbot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-04-08T09:00Z. Staging result: S3 endpoint + uploader = 22s median.

omar_sre: SG updated (sg-09a8b7c6), canary run from Campbell VPC -> collector: 200 OK, S3 object visible in 36s. Marking canary PASS.

leo_cs: Thanks. Action: @tess_security send flow + rotation note, @campbell_cloudadmin confirm KMS policy applied. I'll mark renewal "monitor" until rotation cadence agreed.

campbell_cloudadmin: Policy applied and canary observed. We'll review rotation doc today.
